loc.hill_path.name: Hill Path
loc.hill_path.description: A sheep track climbs from the tavern's back door. The watchtower looms to the north; a green meadow opens to the east.

loc.meadow.name: Shepherd's Meadow
loc.meadow.description: Sheep, stone walls and wind. A few sheep are missing, judging by the feathers and the blood. Crags rise to the north.

loc.harpy_crag.name: Harpy Crag
loc.harpy_crag.description: A jagged outcrop littered with bones and wool. Nests of branches and rags cling to the rock above.

loc.tower_base.name: Foot of the Watchtower
loc.tower_base.description: The old watchtower of the hill watch, black against the sky. The door hangs open. A violet light pulses at the top.

loc.tower_stairs.name: Tower Stairs
loc.tower_stairs.description: A spiral stair open to the wind where the wall has fallen away. Something with wings screeches above you.

loc.tower_top.name: The Hollow Throne
loc.tower_top.description: The top of the tower, roofless under a violet sky. A throne of black iron faces the village. Its occupant is mostly armour, and the armour is mostly empty.

item.harpy_feather.name: Harpy Feather
item.harpy_feather.description: Long, oily and bronze-tipped. Fletchers pay well for these.

item.wool_cloak.name: Wool Cloak
item.wool_cloak.description: Thick, warm and smelling of sheep. The shepherd's best.

item.hollow_crown.name: Hollow Crown
item.hollow_crown.description: A crown of black iron with nothing inside it but cold.

npc.shepherd.name: Shepherd Nell
npc.shepherd.description: A young shepherd with a crook, a sling and a very bad mood.
dialogue: Harpies! Up on the crag! They take a sheep a night.
The tower? Nobody goes up there. The lights started the same week as the harpies. Can't be chance.

npc.harpy.name: Harpy
npc.harpy.description: A woman's face, a vulture's body, and an appetite for mutton.

npc.harpy_matron.name: Harpy Matron
npc.harpy_matron.description: Larger, older and crueller than the others, with talons like sickles.
dialogue: The king feeds us. Who feeds you?

npc.warlock.name: The Hollow King
npc.warlock.description: An empty suit of black armour on an iron throne, a violet flame where its face should be.
dialogue: A hundred years I waited for the bell to crack. Kneel, and I will make you hollow too.

q.harpies.title: Wolves with Wings
q.harpies.description: Shepherd Nell is losing a sheep a night to the harpies of the crag.
